# TheDealMentor.AI

> A CRM with a real CRO inside. DealMentor is a real CRM (pipeline, contacts, activity, tasks) whose every deal is read by an AI CRO that hands back the next move, the script, and the research. Around that spine sit twenty AI sales tools plus a live fractional CRO. It is a system of judgment, not just a system of record. Built by senior sales operators at KSW Solutions.

TheDealMentor.AI serves three audiences: sales teams, BPOs and contact centers, and solo founders. The product is a lightweight but real CRM; what makes it different is that an AI CRO reads each deal and tells the rep what to do next, writes the script, and does the research. The AI is grounded in proven sales methodologies and follows a strict anti-hallucination rule, so it never invents client names, numbers, or results. A live fractional CRO is included as a supporting benefit, not the headline.

## What it does
- [Platform overview](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/platform): The CRM spine plus twenty AI sales tools and a live fractional CRO. The CRM has Deals (stages New to Discovery to Proposal to Negotiation to Won/Lost, with List and Kanban board views, weighted forecast), reusable many-to-many Contacts, a Leads board with one-tap status and one-tap dialing from a contact, LinkedIn profile capture, Activity logging, and typed Tasks. CSV import auto-maps Salesforce and HubSpot exports; one-click CSV export any time. The AI toolkit: sales program generation, ICP scripts, Sales Copilot, Outreach Builder (6 channels), Practice-a-Call simulation, Rep Certification, Knowledge Base, marketing and demand-gen, and Ask-the-CRO (role-aware for managers and reps).
- [For sales teams](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/for-teams): Team Mode generates a 6-document program (Sales Playbook, Why-Buy, Marketing Plan, Vertical Intel, SDR Guide, AE Guide) plus ICP scripts, Practice-a-Call, per-rep Certification, and campaigns a manager assigns to all or specific reps. Managers get a read-only team-pipeline view.
- [For BPOs and contact centers](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/bpo-and-centers): BPO Mode is per-campaign. Paste a client brief and get a Campaign Pack (cheat-sheet, rebuttal library, and certification, a configurable 3-25 questions, default 10) in about a minute, with branded, audit-ready certification records, unique Verification IDs, and PDF or Word export.
- [For solo founders](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/for-founders): Founder Mode generates a 4-document program (GTM Plan, Sales Playbook, Marketing Plan, Daily Workflow) plus the full toolkit.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/pricing): Founder from $119/month (annual) or $149 monthly, 7-day trial. Team from $399/month (annual, up to 5 reps) or $449 monthly, 14-day trial. Growth from $999/month (annual, up to 15 reps) or $1,199 monthly, 14-day trial. BPO / Centers from $999/month, sales-led, monthly billing, 3-month minimum, unlimited agents per campaign, with a 14-day see-it-work trial. Founder, Team, and Growth are self-serve via Paddle. BPO is sales-led: book a call to scope rollout. Reps and agents you invite are covered by your seat and do not pay separately.

## Why DealMentor
- [Why us](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/whyus): To assemble what DealMentor does, a team would otherwise buy a CRM, conversation intelligence, enablement, AI roleplay, and outreach tooling (roughly $67K-112K/year in software by list prices) plus a fractional CRO ($6K-20K/month), which lands around $140K-290K/year all in for about ten reps. DealMentor replaces that stack from $399/month, under $12K/year for up to 15 reps. (Competitor figures are list or reported; the stack comparison applies to teams and founders, not the per-campaign BPO lane.)
- [About](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/about): KSW Solutions and the founder's two decades running this playbook as a fractional CRO.

## Comparisons
- [Compare](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/): How DealMentor differs from the tools teams and BPOs usually buy.
- [vs Salesforce](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/salesforce): A CRM with a CRO inside versus a configurable system of record.
- [vs HubSpot](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/hubspot): Built-in judgment versus an all-in-one you still have to operate.
- [vs Gong](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/gong): Honest read: DealMentor does not do live call recording or conversation intelligence; it acts on the deal, not the call audio.
- [vs Mindtickle](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/mindtickle): Generated enablement and certification versus a standalone enablement suite.
- [vs a fractional CRO](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/fractional-cro): Software that scales the CRO's judgment across every deal versus hours of a human's time.
- [vs Cogito](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/cogito): Real-time call AI versus a bundled playbook, CRM, and CRO.
- [vs Balto](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/balto): Real-time call prompts versus a full sales toolkit.
- [vs Observe.AI](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/observe-ai): Post-call QA analytics versus an upstream sales toolkit.
- [vs Second Nature](https://www.thedealmentor.ai/vs/second-nature): Sales role-play AI versus a full sales toolkit.

## Security and data
DealMentor runs standalone in the browser with no third-party integrations to wire up (no IT project). Hosted on Supabase (managed Postgres) with row-level security, so each account's data is isolated and a rep sees only what they own. Auth is email and password (no SSO yet). AI generation runs through the Anthropic API and your data is not used to train public AI models. DealMentor holds no SOC 2 or ISO certification today; security architecture is walked through on a call for enterprise buyers.
